landing_description: Get measured once. Use it with any Jaylor tailor. Your measurements belong to you.
claim_description: Enter your phone number and we'll send a one-time code on WhatsApp to confirm it's you.
whatsapp_message_first: To protect your details, WhatsApp needs you to message us first. Tap below — it opens WhatsApp with a message ready to send. Your code arrives in the same chat within seconds.
offline_claim: Connect to the internet to claim your Passport.
offline_view: Connect to the internet to see your Passport.
no_measurements_yet: No measurements yet. Ask any Jaylor tailor to measure you and save it to your Passport — it will show up here automatically as soon as your phone number matches.
share_create_then_send: Create a link, then send it to them on WhatsApp.
share_generate_description: Generate a link and QR code. Any Jaylor shop can scan it to bring in your latest measurements instantly.
shops_with_access_note: Measurements a shop has already copied stay in that shop's own records — turning off a share only stops future viewing or importing through that link.
share_dialog_instructions: Show this to a new tailor, or send them the link. If they're not on Jaylor yet, it takes them to sign up first.
first_measurement_nothing: First measurement, nothing to compare yet.
revoke_confirm: Turn off this share link? It will stop working for any shop.
share_off_error: Could not turn off this link
share_create_error: Could not create a share link
verify_error: Something went wrong. Please try again.
